card.text: Explore Tempel 1's published nucleus model from Deep Impact and Stardust-NExT.

introduction.text: Deep Impact struck Tempel 1 in 2005; Stardust returned in 2011. Explore the two encounters separately, alongside the shape model built from both visits.

constraints.title: Shape-constraint map
constraints.summary: Shape measurements mapped onto the nucleus. Solid gray marks stereo measurements, blue marks limb outlines, and the grid marks poorly constrained regions.

model.title: Nucleus shape reconstruction
model.summary: The published nucleus shape, simplified for display. Gray is a model material; the grid marks regions with weaker shape constraints.

deep-impact.title: ITS mosaic
deep-impact.summary: Eight approach images show the surface before impact. Close-ups add detail in smaller patches. Original shadows remain; the grid marks gaps or uncertain shape.

next.title: Encounter image mosaic
next.summary: These images show the surface six years after the 2005 encounter. Lighting differs between visits; the grid marks gaps.
